FQHESphereWithSpinSkyrmionOverlap, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereWithSpinSkyrmionOverlap [options] 

Options:

system options:

    -e, --exact-state : name of the file containing the vector obtained using exact diagonalization

    --list-wavefunctions : list all available test wave fuctions

skyrmion options:
    --polarized-state : file name of polarized fermionic reference wave function (if omitted using analytic function) (multiple arguments)
    -L, --polarizedL : twice the angular momentum of the polarized state (value must be greater than 0, default value = 0)
    -l, --polarized-lzmax : total number of flux quanta (0 if it has to be guessed from input file name) (default value = 0)
    -z, --polarized-lz : twice the total lz value of the polarized vector(s) (0 if it has to be guessed from input file name)
    --bosonic-state : file name of spinful bosonic part of wave function (multiple arguments)

    --bosonicL : twice the angular momentum of the polarized state (default value = 0)
    --skyrmionL : twice the angular momentum of the skyrmion trial state (default value = 0)
    --skyrmion-lz : twice the angular momentum projection Lz of the skyrmion trial state (default value = 0)
    --min-parallel : minimum dimension of bosonic space before parallel evaluation is applied (default value = 5000)

analytical wave function options:
    --test-wavefunction : name of the test wave fuction
    --nbr-flux : number of quantum flux attached to each particle (laughlin and *cf only) (value must be greater than 0, default value = 1)
    --cluster-size : number of particles per cluster (read only) (value must be greater than 2, default value = 3)
    --nbr-level : number of pseudo Landau levels (filledcf only) (value must be greater than 1, default value = 1)
    --cf-file : name of the file describing the composite fermion state (genericcf only)
    --MR-coeff : coefficient for Moore-Read contribution (pairedcf only) (default value = 1)
    --pair-coeff : sequence of pairing coefficients (pairedcf only)
    --pair-compatibility : adopt old conventions for normalisation (pairedcf only)
    --fermion-state : generate a fermionic wavefunction (RR)
    --CF-levels : number of CF levels to fill (><0) (SLBS) (default value = -2)
    --Jz-Value : Total angular momentum Jz (hund only) (default value = 0)
    --hund-L2 : Total angular momentum J if less than maximal (hund only) (default value = -1)
    --JM-Values : Angular momentum J and projection on z axis J,M (paired2QH only)
    --QHMC-iter : Number of MC steps for internal MC (paired2QH only) (default value = 1000)

Monte Carlo options:
    -i, --nbr-iter : number of Monte Carlo iterations (default value = 10000)
    -t, --nbr-warmup-iter : number of steps for thermalization (default value = 500)
    --display-step : number of iteration between two consecutive result displays (default value = 1000)
    --randomSeed : seed to be used to initialize random number generator (default value = -1)
    -H, --history-mode : use on-file history: (0=off, 1=generate new, 2=read history, 3=optimize with history, 4=continue to generate given history) (default value = 1)
    --history-file : name of the file where overlap recording has to be done
    --varyMR : vary coefficient of 1/z in pair wavefunction

    --show-details : show intermediate values used for overlap calculation

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode

    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

Precalculation options:
    --fast-search : amount of memory that can be allocated for fast state search (in Mbytes) (default value = 9)

    --load-hilbert : load Hilbert space description from the indicated file (only available for the haldane or symmetrized bases)

misc options:
